planned_endpoints.summary: Find cost category corresponding with sent data.
Find payment type corresponding with sent data.

rules: ALWAYS search first: GET /employee?email=<email> — the sandbox often has pre-existing employees. Reuse if found.
Only POST /employee if GET returns 0 results.
When POSTing, ALWAYS include department={"id": dept_id}. Create department first if needed.
userType should be 'NO_ACCESS' (safest default — avoids 422 errors). Only use 'STANDARD' if email login is explicitly needed.
startDate is a TOP-LEVEL field on the employee object. Do NOT put it inside an employments array.
dateOfBirth is a TOP-LEVEL field. Format: 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
jobTitle is set via PUT /employee/{id} AFTER creation — it cannot be set in the initial POST.
Do NOT include an 'employments' array in POST /employee — employment details go via separate POST /employee/employment endpoint.

For occupation codes (STYRK/yrkeskode): POST /employee/employment first, then GET /employee/employment/occupationCode?nameAndCode=XXXX to find the code, then PUT /employee/employment/details to set it.
ALWAYS include project={"id": project_id} if prompt mentions a project.
Paths must NOT include /v2/ prefix — use /travelExpense not /v2/travelExpense.

payload.headline: All 5 checks failed despite seemingly correct logic; likely wrong cost category or VAT handling
what_went_wrong: All 5 scoring checks failed (0/10), suggesting a fundamental mismatch in expense category, VAT type, or department assignment.
Agent chose 'Representasjon - fradragsb.' but the task says 'Middag representasjon' — the correct category may be 'Representasjon - ikke fradragsb.' or a specific 'Middag' category.
The cost line POST /travelExpense/cost returned no resource_id (None), suggesting it may have silently failed or the response was not properly captured.
Payment type 'Privat utlegg' was used but the receipt indicates 'Bedriftskort' (company card) — no company card payment type was found/used, which may have caused check failures.
what_worked: Travel expense header was created successfully (id 11152510) with correct date and department HR.
Zero 4xx errors across all 8 API calls — clean execution flow.
what_to_try_next: Try 'Representasjon - ikke fradragsb.' as the cost category instead, as Norwegian dinner representation is typically non-deductible for both VAT and income tax.
Investigate why POST /travelExpense/cost returned no resource_id — verify the cost line was actually persisted and check if required fields like currency or vatType were missing.
Search for a company card payment type more thoroughly (e.g., query with different params) since the receipt explicitly states 'Bedriftskort' and using wrong payment type likely fails a check.
unnecessary_calls: Second GET /travelExpense/costCategory call was redundant — first call returned 15 of 36 items; should have used count/from params to paginate instead of re-fetching.
GET /travelExpense/paymentType could have been combined with cost category lookup in a single planning step to reduce round trips.
